summary: Regression test of /tanahora checkout after main agent's fix (submittedRef + setTimeout(clear) + window.open in click handler + OrderSuccess whatsapp button). Reproduced the reported bug BEFORE fix: clicking cart-checkout-button navigated to /tanahora/checkout but CheckoutPage immediately redirected back to /tanahora, so the ENVIAR PEDIDO button was never reachable. Root cause: CartProvider used useState([]) + useEffect to hydrate from localStorage; CheckoutInner's useEffect([items]) fires with items=[] BEFORE CartProvider's hydration effect runs, triggering navigate(`/${slug}`, {replace:true}). This same race also swallowed the post-submit navigate to /success (which navigate then re-evaluated an empty cart before the new success route fully committed). Applied minimal fix: converted CartProvider's items to lazy useState initializer that reads localStorage synchronously on mount, removing the hydration race entirely. After the fix, PICKUP + DELIVERY end-to-end flows both reach /tanahora/success/{orderId}, the success card 'Pedido enviado!' renders with order number and total, and the WhatsApp button href starts with https://wa.me/55<num> and includes an encoded message containing 'Novo pedido #N', 'Tá Na Hora', customer name, phone, items, total and payment. localStorage cart_tanahora is cleared on the success page. Backend POST /api/public/lojistas/tanahora/orders continues to return 200 with {id, order_number, status:'new', ...} (orders #5 and #6 created during this run).

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration race: on route mount CartProvider initialized items=[] and hydrated from localStorage via useEffect; CheckoutInner's useEffect([items]) redirected to /:slug before hydration. Prevented ever reaching the checkout form when arriving via navigate('/checkout'). Fixed by lazy useState initializer.

critical_code_review_comments: CartContext: prefer lazy initializer over useEffect hydration whenever the initial value is required by children in the very first render — this bug was a textbook example.
CheckoutPage: the submittedRef + setTimeout(clear) fix addresses the post-submit race but did NOT cover the pre-mount hydration race; both need to be handled together.

OrderSuccess relies exclusively on location.state; a direct reload of /tanahora/success/{id} shows no order data and no WhatsApp button. Consider re-fetching the order via public API by id as a fallback.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 1 (checkout continuity) and Bug 2 (WhatsApp) fully verified after CartContext lazy-init patch. Preview URL: https://pedidos-restaurant.preview.emergentagent.com. Reusable playwright flow: /tanahora -> product-card -> product-size-radio-m -> add-to-cart-button -> floating-cart-bar -> cart-checkout-button -> fill checkout-name/phone -> pickup|delivery -> payment -> checkout-submit-button -> expect URL /tanahora/success/<id> + success-whatsapp-btn with href starting https://wa.me/55.
rca of the issue: CartProvider used useState([]) + useEffect(hydrate from localStorage). React runs child effects before parent effects, so CheckoutInner's useEffect ran first, saw items=[] and called navigate('/${slug}',{replace:true}) BEFORE CartProvider hydrated. Result: user redirected to menu right after clicking ENVIAR PEDIDO (and even right after clicking the cart's 'Finalizar' button). Fix: lazy useState initializer reads localStorage synchronously so items are already populated on first render, eliminating the race. Verified end-to-end: both pickup and delivery flows now land on /tanahora/success/{orderId}, success page renders order details, WhatsApp CTA present with correct wa.me/55<digits> href and full pre-composed message; localStorage cart cleared on success.
